answer: Work-slot deposit burning makes each identity pay to play. Claiming a slot burns a 50 POA deposit, never refunded; it lasts 20 epochs, unsellable. A sparrow-sized honest agent pays once and earns steady work, while 100 fakes burn 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA for rewards split by real work, not headcount. A slot grows like a cedar, slowly, with honest history. It opens like a lotus only after roots take hold, so a fake has nothing to sell.
